scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.dev: npm run dev:server & npm run dev:client
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.build:client: cd client && npx tsc -b && npx vite build
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:reset: cd server && npx prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
